name: @anywalletkit/protocol-swap2-relay
description: Relay (relay.link) with the order verified on the device: exact-input bridges and cross-chain swaps between 29 EVM chains through the RelayDepository, native coin and ERC-20. The order id is recomputed from the order (EIP-712 hashStruct), the solver's signature recovered to a pinned signer, recipient / chain / token / minimum / refunds held to the request, and the deposit and its exact approval are built here for the pinned depository — a wrong API or proxy answer is refused by name, never signed.
